conversation_starters.title: 'I'm going to be depressed for a long time.' | Historic Crystal Ballroom destroyed in fire, leaving community mourning the site
conversation_starters.summary: Beloved historic venue destroyed by fire; community mourning. Widely known local landmark loss, work-safe opener. You could open with: 'Did you hear the Crystal Ballroom burned down? I heard so many big acts played there.'
conversation_starters.description: The owner of the ballroom says big acts like Selena, Ramon Ayala, and Intocable performed there, and hosted many quinceaneras, weddings, and other parties.

conversation_starters.title: 'I had it there for years': Office decoration in Atascosa County turns out to be live, Civil War-era explosive
conversation_starters.summary: Quirky, fun local oddity story. You could open with: 'Did you hear someone had a Civil War-era live explosive as an office decoration in Atascosa County?'
conversation_starters.description: An explosive ordnance disposal unit was brought out from Lackland Air Force Base. The device was confirmed to be a Parrott round from more than 150 years ago.

you_should_know.title: Congressman Joaquin Castro renews call to close Dilley detention center after congressional oversight visit
you_should_know.summary: Congressman renews call to close a detention center — institutional/political immigration story landing on the region. Political-institutional context worth walking in aware of; not a check-in and not a safe opener.
you_should_know.description: U.S. Rep. Joaquin Castro advocates for closing the Dilley detention center, citing poor conditions causing trauma to children and adults.
